contracts_rationale: No new interface: the mission tightens existing frontmatter validation, corrects the OKF export generated block and adds a test; no API, schema or route changes.
friendly_name: Dates, actors and anchors: follow-ups from #181 and #218
purpose_context: Follow-ups from the content-graph and single-h1 work (#181, #218). Three outputs pick a page's last-changed date by their own rules and the OKF export can report a stale scaffold time; the date parser accepts values like "1" as real dates; and one single-h1 anchor branch has no test. This mission records and enforces a documented per-output date precedence, rejects non-date-shaped values while keeping every realistic form that built before, and pins the anchor-collision case with a test.
purpose_tldr: Make page dates trustworthy across RSS, the OKF export and the agent API, reject non-date values, and pin the heading-anchor edge case.
